verdict: MEDIUM (inert, no secrets; fix quadratic regex DoS before wiring)

findings.issue: Quadratic runtime: _AFTER_REF_LABEL.search(text[:m.start()]) runs per match over the whole prefix. 200KB of 'R1 ' repeated took ~50s (also 'ref R1 ' repeated ~46s). A hostile sender or third-party text can stall the cycle. Severity depends on whether it runs before sender auth.
findings.fix: Cap typed-region length (e.g. 20KB) before parsing, and check the ref label with a bounded window such as text[max(0,m.start()-40):m.start()]. Run text parsing only after authenticate_sender passes.

findings.issue: sanitize_provider_message applies _TOKEN/_ADDRESS regexes to the full untruncated string before the 200-char cut. 'a'*200000+'!' took ~65s. The input is provider-controlled, so exposure is low.
findings.fix: Truncate to about 2000 characters first, then redact, then cut to 200.

findings.issue: OWN_MSGID_RE is an unanchored search with a nested optional group. A Message-ID of '.invespend-notification.' repeated 10k times took ~19s, and the Message-ID is attacker-controlled. It is not a bypass, because a match only drops the message.
findings.fix: Truncate message_id to 998 characters (the RFC line limit) before matching, or use a possessive pattern '\.invespend-notification(?:\.[^@.]*)*@'.

findings.issue: The left boundary excludes only letters and digits, so reference-like tokens such as 'INV-R500', 'PO/R500' and 'Order#R500' still count as marked amounts. The ref-label guard covers only 'ref'/'reference'. Also, R\s?(ASCII) allows a newline between R and the number.
findings.fix: Add '-', '/', '#', '_' and '.' to the lookbehind of _PREFIXED, and use [ \t] instead of \s?. Reconciliation against the instruction must stay mandatory.

findings.issue: Trust model relies on the receiving MTA stripping or overwriting inbound Authentication-Results, and on topmost-only reading with an exact authserv-id. If the MTA does not strip a forged header with a trusted authserv-id, it can be forged. Code-level attacks tried (comment/quote injection, group syntax, multiple From, non-ASCII, plus-address, subdomain, absent dmarc) all fail closed. The allowlist and authserv-id are caller-supplied, and an empty set denies all.
findings.fix: Document the MTA requirement in the runbook. Add an operational preflight that checks the real mailbox's topmost A-R authserv-id.

findings.issue: No gate loosened. _opt_cap is fail-closed, and PAYMENTS_DRY_RUN stays default true with LIVE_ENABLE default false. .env.example now ships non-zero cap examples (20000/50000), but caps alone do not enable payments. If anyone copies .env.example to .env, only the caps become non-zero.
